concerns.text: T007 (Calculate baseline_stats.json) is ordered BEFORE T006 (Generate synthetic_baseline.csv) completes. T007 explicitly requires reading 'data/raw/synthetic_baseline.csv' to calculate the mean, but T006 is the producer of this file. T007 must be moved to after T006.

T010 (Generate ingestion_metrics.json) is listed in Phase 1, but it depends on T013 (Implement orchestration in ingest.py) which is in Phase 2. T010 requires 'rows_ingested' and 'null_counts' which are only produced by the ingestion logic in T013. T010 must be moved to Phase 2, after T013.

T026 (Held-out test set evaluation) depends on T024 (Random Forest training) and T027 (Save model). T026 requires the model to be trained and saved to compare MAE against the baseline. T026 is currently listed before T027 (Save model) and T024 is marked [X] but T027 is not. T026 must follow T027.

T033 (Ensure Interaction Model consistency) depends on T027 (Save trained model to kinetic_model.pkl). T033 attempts to load 'artifacts/models/kinetic_model.pkl' which is the output of T027. T033 is correctly placed after T027, but T032 (Baseline Model) is placed before T033. T032 is independent of T033 but both depend on T023 (Data Split). The order is acceptable, but T034 (Delta-Permutation Test) depends on T032 and T033. T034 is correctly placed after them.

T036 (SHAP Interaction Value analysis) depends on T019 (Interaction feature engineering) and T027 (Trained model). T036 is correctly placed after T027, but T019 is in Phase 2. The dependency is satisfied, but T036 should explicitly reference T019's output 'data/processed/engineered_features.csv' to ensure the data flow is clear.

T008 (Implement orchestration in main.py) is marked [X] (complete) but logically depends on T006 (Generate synthetic data) and T013 (Ingest) to function as an orchestrator. While T008 might be a skeleton, the description says it 'must be the single entry point that calls the ingestion, feature engineering, training, and evaluation scripts'. If T013 and T019 are not complete, T008 cannot be fully functional. This is a semantic dependency issue.
